scope: Preliminary complete construction of buried cast-in-place reinforced-concrete clean-water reservoirs from primary internal geometry: earthworks, concrete structure, reinforcement, formwork, waterproofing, potable coating, embedded reservoir appurtenances, consumables, labor, mechanisms, logistics, quality records and procurement balances.
calculatedScope: useful storage capacity and excavation geometry from internal dimensions and the visible structural profile
blinding, base slab, external walls, dividing walls, roof slab, columns and total structural concrete
reinforcement, formwork, external waterproofing, potable-water coating and waterstop joint length
concrete, reinforcement and waterstop stock, waste, supplier-lot order, remainder and surplus balances
hatches, ladders, vents, penetrations, reservoir piping kits, sealing and commissioning consumables
excavation, backfill, excess-soil removal, labor, mechanisms, deliveries, testing and completion records
conditionalProjectFacts: excavation shoring system when shoring is required
dewatering pump, duration and discharge when groundwater control is required
excludedScope: external distribution pipelines, pumping or treatment stations and separate valve chambers
road restoration, rock excavation, piling and permanent groundwater-lowering systems
simultaneous selection with the legacy approved-BOQ water_reservoir owner for the same physical reservoir
prices or manufacturer performance not supplied by a confirmed source
truthBoundary: This visible preliminary engineering profile is not an approved structural design, geotechnical report, method statement or universal norm. Primary geometry drives all arithmetic automatically; structural thicknesses, reinforcement intensities, productivity, loss, supplier-lot and conditional values remain visible, editable and require project confirmation. The approved-BOQ water_reservoir profile is an alternative owner, never an additive duplicate.
